title: Figure 12: MCap Structure - Magnetic Capacitor Nanocell and Cell
description: Schematic of a Northern Lights Semiconductor magnetic capacitor (MCap) nanocell, a layered block of magnetic materials sandwiching a dielectric layer, dimensioned 1.6 μm by 0.55 μm and labeled 'all proprietary compositions'. A dashed outline shows an array forming an 'MCap cell — Made up of millions MCap nanocells'. Caption notes MCap nanocells and cells are fabricated using traditional semiconductor fabrication processes.
